source: Read on 2026-10-18 from the Google Maps listing (cid 2659342198248692643) in a signed-in session, sorted newest, original language, reviewer text only (owner replies excluded). Google loads at most about 400 reviews per session, so this holds the newest 390, back to about two years. Rating and total are the listing's own figures. Names are shortened at source because this repository is public.

reviews.text: Looking for Indian/Vegetarian options, so this is the place one must visit. Honestly speaking this is the best choice than the one around with name of Indian goddess. The reason saying that firstly I tried ordering from them through a local food delivery app., but the taste, quantity and also quantity was horrible. I m mentioning this not as a promotion of this restaurant but to have a fair option to have food like home away from home. The guy Nikunj here will u like at country away from country... Thank-you 🙏

reviews.text:

The reception of the staff, courtesy and service were outstanding.  Food was excellent with the right level of spicing and portions served.  We are delighted with our experience. reviews.text:
We had a wonderful evening at Jaipur Restaurant in Freiburg. After travelling through Europe, I had been craving a good chicken dish and hadn’t found one easily. The spicy chicken with rice here was exactly what I was hoping for, delicious, satisfying and full of flavour

From the moment we arrived, the warm and friendly service made us feel welcome. The cosy, homely atmosphere gave us a chance to relax and enjoy our meal. Thank you to the whole team at Jaipur Restaurant for making our evening so special. We would happily visit again. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Anup P.

Highly recommended if you’re in Freiburg! ❤️

reviews.author: nisha P.
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Honestly one of the best meals we’ve had on our Europe trip so far! The food was absolutely delicious and really hit the spot. 😍

A big thank you to Nikunj for the amazing service — he was so friendly and looked after us really well. We also met the owners, who were such lovely and welcoming people.

If you’re in Freiburg and looking for great Indian food, definitely give Jaipur a try. Great food, great service and lovely people. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Pratikk P.
reviews.text:
We visited Jaipur Indian Restaurant today while holidaying from Australia, and absolutely loved it. The ambience was welcoming, the staff were kind, and our group of ten was seated immediately.

The Kadhai Paneer, Dal Makhni, Butter Naan, and complimentary rice were all delicious and full of flavour. Prices were reasonable, and the kids also enjoyed the food.

Highly recommend this place for authentic Indian food and great hospitality.

Good service, good food and ambience.

reviews.author: Lee S.
reviews.text:
Honestly, had an amazing meal at Jaipur today. The food is delicious and doesn’t taste like the typical, toned-down Indian food you usually get in Germany—it has real, authentic flavor.
We ate inside, and since my mother uses a walker, the staff immediately noticed and made sure to give us a large, comfortable table. The waiters were super nice. One of the soups we ordered turned out to be too spicy for us, and the manager actually came over, thanked us for the feedback, and replaced the dish with no hesitation.
It’s not cheap, but it is worth every penny for both the food and the incredible service. I will definitely be coming back a lot. Highly recommend!

reviews.text: Rassismus! (Konflikt Nepal vs. Indien!) Katastrophales Erlebnis gehabt: der Kellner schüttete absichtlich Sauce über einen Nepali an unserem Tisch. Keine Entschuldigung, keine Wiedergutmachung. Das Essen schmeckte 2/10 und am nächsten Tag mussten wir alle häufig die Toilette besuchen. Von Hygiene kann hier keine Rede sein. Insgesamt eher unfreundliche Art der Kellner und trotz des großen Fehlers, den er machte, hat er keine Entschuldigung über die Lippen bringen können. Geht lieber woanders hin, wenn ihr euren Körper schonen wollt.

reviews.author: Black Pirate A.
reviews.text:
Ambiente
Recht schlicht und (natürlich) indisch angehaucht. Aber kein überbordender India-Kitsch oder ähnliches. Man sitzt gemütlich und etwas enger, aber alles in Ordnung. Im Sommer Terrasse im Innenhof (der zwar nicht besonders ist, aber immerhin).
Essen
Superklasse. Gute Speisekarte, breites Angebot. Und alles total lecker. Indischer Tapasteller war ein fantastischer Starter. Chicken Tikka Masala einfach top. Unbedingt bestellen: Garlic Naan Brot. Noch nie so gegessen.
Service
Höflich, zuvorkommend, geräuschlos, schnell. Einfach Klasse!
Preis/Leistung
Hier passt alles. Und wenn man die Freiburger City-Lage bedenkt….

We visited this restaurant yesterday and had a really great experience. The food, service, and overall atmosphere were all impressive.

For vegetarian dishes, we ordered roti, mixed vegetables, palak paneer, and the chef’s special paneer tikka masala. Everything tasted fresh and full of flavor, and the portion sizes were generous.

From the non-vegetarian menu, we tried chicken curry and chicken tikka, and both were equally delicious. The mango lassi was also a highlight — perfectly refreshing and well made.

Overall, the quality of food, the quantity, and the service made it a very satisfying visit. Would definitely recommend!

reviews.text: Wer die Aromen der indischen klassischen Kochkunst erleben möchte, ohne dafür nach Indien zu reisen, ist hier im Zentrum von Freiburg richtig: in der Dietlerpassage am Bertoldsbrunnen. Vorspeisen, Gerichte - mit oder ohne Fleisch und Getränke sowie Nachtisch verlocken zur Wahl, siehe Fotos. Wir waren heute hier sechs Personen und alle sehr zufrieden.

reviews.author: Abhishek M.
reviews.text:
We tried Jaipur Restaurant recently and were genuinely impressed. The food felt refined and well thought out. Rich without being heavy, flavorful without being overwhelming. Every dish tasted intentional, not rushed or generic, which is honestly rare.

What I appreciated most was how well-balanced everything was. The spices were layered and nuanced rather than just “hot,” and even familiar dishes felt elevated. It’s the kind of place where you can tell the kitchen really understands Indian cuisine instead of just reproducing standard recipes.

The service was warm, attentive, and calm. We never felt rushed, and the staff were happy to explain dishes or make recommendations. The whole experience felt relaxed and welcoming.

Definitely a place worth visiting if you’re looking for high quality Indian food in Freiburg, we’ll be coming back!

reviews.author: Komal K.
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful experience at Jaipur. The food was amazing - not the usual run-of-the-mill Indian dishes, but thoughtfully prepared. We had a bunch of starters and main course for dinner and found every dish to be just as good as the other. Special mention: the kulfi — made in house — was honestly exceptional. Easily one of the best I’ve had.

Personally for me, what also stood out was the atmosphere. The décor is beautiful and feels genuinely meaningful with pieces of Indian history and art. It makes the space feel warm, authentic, and special.

The staff were incredibly kind, attentive, and welcoming, which made the whole evening even better.

Overall, this was possibly one of the best Indian restaurant experiences I’ve had in Germany. Highly recommend, and we’ll definitely be back.

reviews.author: M. H.
reviews.text:
Ein ausgesprochen angenehmes Restaurant mit freundlich zurückhaltendem und stets aufmerksamem Personal, das niemals aufdringlich wirkt. Die indische Küche überzeugt durch handwerkliche Qualität und klare Differenzierung: Jedes Gericht besitzt ein eigenes sensorisches Profil, die Gewürze sind fein und ausgewogen komponiert. Das Ambiente ist einladend; die nicht zu dicht gestellte Bestuhlung erlaubt ein Maß an Privatsphäre, das wir sehr schätzen.
Als Vegetarier können wir ausschließlich die fleischlosen Gerichte beurteilen, diese haben uns jedoch durchweg überzeugt. Besonders das hausgemachte Paneer sowie der aromatische Masala-Lassi zählen zu unseren persönlichen Favoriten. Als Paar fühlen wir uns hier sehr gut aufgehoben. Ein Restaurant ohne Chichi, dafür mit Authentizität, Sorgfalt und spürbarer Wertschätzung gegenüber seinen Gästen.

reviews.author: Coldplay C.
reviews.text: I would highly not recommend this Indian restaurant. The Bhel puri is just the Haldiram packet served for 5-6€. The Chai tea was just hot water mixed with powder and the glass wasn't washed properly. The mango lassi had strong food coloring. The place might look good from the outside but it appeared very unhygienic. Also, the cashier during the weekend was not friendly at all. If you want to ruin your Indian dining experience, please visit this place.

reviews.author: Dorothy M.
reviews.text: Friendly staff, great food. I had a vegan chickpea with masala sauce. It was delicious like homemade food. No overpowering seasonings or oily. A must try!

Gave complementary Naan and snacks at the end which was quite surprising!. Very nice and preaceful restaurant.

reviews.author: Pankaj K.
reviews.text: Great food . Staff is very supportive. Must visit place

reviews.author: Darshan K.
reviews.text:
Worst food ever...

edit after Owner comment.

Yes, me and my friends felt bad after having dinner here. Because our hard money got wasted on this unauthentic and mis guided recipes. Our chicken and paneer curry tastes were same. As we indians know the taste difference between Tikka and paneer curries. I believe that's the pain point for you. I understand you can fool non natives but common have courtesy when you serves south east Asians. After all you are serving food in the name of Indian. No wonder we hardly saw any south east Asian people in restaurant except staff. I hope you work upon your food rather than chasing and lecturing person here. 🙏

reviews.author: Faeeza Saleem H.
reviews.text: Authentic and tasty Indian food, the staff is very friendly and hospitable. Large portions for each dish, and the atmosphere is really amazing. Would recommend 10/10!

reviews.author: Abhanjali M.

reviews.author: Saurabh M.
reviews.text: This was easily one of the best Indian meals we’ve had in Europe—possibly the very best. The food was authentic and full of flavor, and Nikunj, along with the rest of the staff, was warm, friendly, and a pleasure to chat with. We truly enjoyed our time here.

reviews.author: Sabi D.
reviews.text: Really recommend

reviews.author: TobiVanKenobi
reviews.text:
Zentral gelegener Inder mit solidem Essem.
Wir hatten 4 Gerichte und von mild bis scharf war alles dabei. Die typische Würzung der indischen Küche war etwas zurückhaltend, was den einzelnen Zutaten aber gut tut. Der Service war leider etwas zögerlich, aber es gab einen Schnaps am Ende. Gerade der Digestiv ist leider eine Seltenheit geworden, weshalb das ein großes Lob ist.
Resümee: Hingehn und Genießen!

reviews.author: Devil H.
reviews.text: Good food great Service!!

reviews.author: Ibopishak S.
reviews.text: Friendly staff who accommodated us without a reservation and offered a complementary drink at the end of our meal. Food is delicious, we ordered vegetarian food so cannot comment on non-vegetarian dishes. Overall, in the center of Freiburg, so conveniently located and easy to find with a lot of items in the menu.

reviews.author: Carlotta V.
reviews.text: Eravamo un gruppo di 8, servizio veloce e gentile, piatti curati e molto buoni

reviews.author: Erik V.
reviews.text: Restaurant bevindt zich op de eerste verdieping van een klein complex. Aangenaam binnenterras. Geen opdringerige bediening, lekkere keuken, normale prijzen. Ik at chicken tikka massala met rijst en naanbrood en dronk er een mango lassi bij.

reviews.author: Dawn S.
reviews.text: What a fantastic place.my husband and I were lucky enough to visit Jaipur tonight .we are a couple from England that were looking for somewhere to eat whilst visiting freiburg.the welcome we received was warm and we felt at home immediately.the food was Excellent.so much to choose from the staff were attentive very polite and extremely friendly.The service was fantastic and the surroundings were exceptional.we enjoyed our evening so much we are returning again tomorrow night.please don't miss this restaurant if you are in town .I promise you won't be disappointed.5 star is how we rate it.

reviews.author: F B.
reviews.text: Viel gehört, aber bislang noch nie ausprobiert. Heute war es soweit und wir haben zum ersten Mal im Restaurant „Jaipur“ in der Freiburger ‚Dietler Passage’ gegessen. Es war hervorragend und wir waren sehr zufrieden! Die Gerichte waren sehr gut ausbalanciert und toll gewürzt, der Service war zuvorkommend und rundum freundlich. Gerne kommen wir wieder…

reviews.author: Dana A.
reviews.text: The waiter was very very rude. At the beginning, I told him that I want to cancel a specific item. He spoke to me in a bad way and told me that it’s not allowed to cancel the order, and that this was unacceptable for me, because I had the right to cancel what I want from the beginning. I did not like their dealing with the customers at all, and I will not visit this restaurant again.. also the restaurant was hot inside. The food was normal nothing special.

reviews.author: Anoushka M.
reviews.text: good north indian option! we enjoyed their masala and mango lassi, kadahi paneer and daal makhani. kadahi paneer and paneer butter masala (both good) had the same gravy, with different veggies, so wouldn’t recommend ordering them simultaneously. service was lacking - we came here twice and received gravies before the rotis, which resulted in gravies cooling down somewhat before we could start eating. looked like they were short on staff, could benefit from hiring more waitstaff. overall, good experience and food - we enjoyed eating here twice, and would come again!

reviews.author: Bharathi M.
reviews.text:
We really enjoyed the food at this place and went twice during our 2 day stay at Freiberg.
The masala lassi as well as Mango lassi were very refreshing.
The karahi paneer and dal makhani were very good.
The service was quite slow. Maybe shortage of help in summer

reviews.author: Aryaman
reviews.text: Great food. Got the Kadahi Paneer, Paneer tikka masala, and Dal Makhani which were all fantastic. Especially loved the Masala Lassi which was at the level of back home!

reviews.author: Pratik K.
reviews.text: Food was ok for Indian cuisine. However the staff and service was absolutely horrid. They were rude and downright not so caring. Wont visit again

reviews.author: Ramona W.
reviews.text: Das Essen im Jaipur war richtig gut. Besonders das Naan war fluffig und frisch. Auch der Service war freundlich und aufmerksam. Wer echte nordindische Küche in Freiburg sucht, ist hier genau richtig. Ich komme definitiv wieder!

reviews.author: T. K.
reviews.text: I tried their Vegetarian 'Thali' (Plate) yesterday (Friday) for lunch. Good that each dish tasted different and had their own authentic flavor. The Naan piece wasn’t good at all. Very rubbery. I was looking for sweet lassi but they either had salty Lassi or mango sweet lassi. The restaurant looked very busy and enjoys a great location in the old town.

The overall atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant, making it a perfect spot for a casual meal or a special outing. I’m already looking forward to coming back and trying more dishes.

reviews.author: G. C.
reviews.text:
Das Restaurant liegt in guter Lage und bietet ein schönes Ambiente – hier fühlt man sich grundsätzlich wohl.

Wir bestellten zwei Vorspeisen (für mich) und ein Hauptgericht und baten darum, alles gleichzeitig zu servieren. Die Bedienung bestätigte das freundlich und wiederholte es sogar zweimal. Leider wurde dieser Wunsch nicht umgesetzt:

Zuerst kam meine warme Vorspeise allein, dann das Hauptgericht – und die zweite Vorspeise wurde erst danach serviert. Dadurch mussten wir getrennt essen, was wirklich schade war und den Besuch getrübt hat.

Geschmacklich war das Essen gut, allerdings waren die Portionen – sowohl beim Hauptgericht als auch bei der Suppe – eher klein. Angesichts der Preise finde ich das nicht angemessen.

Insgesamt war es leider kein rundes Erlebnis für mich, und ich würde persönlich nicht noch einmal kommen. Schade.

Der Service ist super und die Bedingungen sind super freundlich und fröhlich. Sie bringen jedem Gast ein Lächeln aufs Gesicht.
Ich würde wieder hin gehen und kann es jedem empfehlen.

reviews.author: Charles L.

reviews.author: Bruno K.
reviews.text: Guter Inder im Zentrum von Freiburg. Preis/Leistung passt, das Essen war gut. Atmosphäre ist eher nüchtern und die Kleider riechen nach dem Besuch stark, da es eine offene Küche gibt. Nette und speditive Bedienung.

reviews.author: J to the E.
reviews.text: Super tolles und leckeres Essen, tolles Ambiente und sehr nettes Personal. Sind dort nur durch Zufall gelandet, weil es das Restaurant, in das wir wollten, nicht mehr gibt. Aber nur so haben wir dieses tolle Restaurant kennengelernt.

reviews.author: Apurv N.
reviews.text: Good food and quick service

reviews.author: janvi G.
reviews.text: Best Indian taste we have enjoyed till now in Germany. Cozy and friendly atmosphere. Special thanks to Nikunj Sakariya who served the best food to us.

reviews.text: Food was super tasty. Worth it for the price. Service was good and quick. Servers were smiling and friendly and well behaved. Ambience of the hotel was good. Overall a good experience and a must try.

reviews.author: Sofia M.
reviews.text:
We had a table for 1.5 hours (18:00-19:30), what’s normally more than enough for us. We made an order 10 min after we arrived (18:10), but food got served at 19:10! We hade a feeling that they simply forgot about our order, and after more than 50 min of waiting we asked waiter again. Waiters and chef started coming every 5 min after we finally got food and asking if everything good (which was annoying and inappropriate after hour of waiting). We had one evening in Freiburg, and didn’t plan to spend such a long time for dinner. The food was good, but the service was so bad that we will never return. Jaipur is worth visiting only if you’re ready to wait and endure just to finally have a meal.

Response:

Yes, that’s exactly the problem—you weren’t even busy, and we waited for 50 minutes.
It’s your job to explain the reason for the delay. All I needed was to know how soon our order would arrive. That was the exact question asked to the waiter. The answer was that it would be brought right away. We waited another 10 minutes.

In any case, I wish you success in correcting your mistakes in the coming year & a Merry Christmas.

reviews.author: Muhammad Talha M.
reviews.text:
Short Version: Go there not just for amazing authentic desi indian food but also for their generous service and warm hospitality

My family couldn't find any spot anywhere during peak holiday season and we just happened to come across this hidden gem. And we were just amazed at everything. The staff and everyone literally went out of their way to make us feel welcome and every thing we ordered was just made to perfection. I'm very picky about Indian restaurants in Europe this one topped my list.

We got Achari Gosht which was so tender it was melting in our mouth. And also Chicken Tikka which paired with their chutney was just amazing. Oh and don't forget their bread basket so you can try all their best naans.

It's an easy to miss place because you can't see it from the street directly but be prepared for an amazing experience.

Eine 12/10!!!

reviews.author: Patrick H.
reviews.text:
I have received a complaint through Google from this restaurant regarding a review I posted some time ago. I am accused of defamation. I have written to Google for the review but they have not replied. So I don't know what I wrote. However, as a former professional restaurant reviewer for a major guidebook publisher and a multi-times visitor to India I can only trade on my knowledge and experience. So I can only presume that the restaurant didn't not like my review and complained to Google.
You can make your own mind up.

reviews.text: Super leckeres indisches Essen. Wir waren begeistert!

reviews.author: Max G.
reviews.text: Das Essen ist zu 95% wirklich gut, ab und zu leider eine kleine Lotterie. Schade, dass bei den Preisen nicht zwischen in-house und to go unterschieden wird, sonst würden wir sicher häufiger bestellen/abholen.

reviews.author: Michael K.
reviews.text:
Haben heute sehr gut gegessen.
Angenehme Atmosphäre, freundliche Bedienung

reviews.author: Russo M.
reviews.text: Never have I had a more pleasant meal. Anna was so polite and helpful, going above and beyond to make us feel welcome. Thanks Anna for the wonderful care given to us. Forever repeat customers!

reviews.author: Maximilian M.
reviews.text: Ambiente nicht ansprechend essen aber super. Probiert das Naan Brot mit bitte und Knoblauch

reviews.author: Thomas L.
reviews.text:
Hallo zusammen,
Also der Service war sehr nett.
Aber Leute, das was wir hatten war langweilig, geschmacklos und trocken.
Sorry … aber das geht sicherlich besser.

reviews.author: Sarah H.
reviews.text: This restaurant tries to silence unhappy customers by raising complaints of defamation with google rather than improving food quality and service standards!!! Jaipur - no idea what I’m talking about?!?! Shameful bullying behaviour

reviews.author: morteza T.
reviews.text:
The food was not bad. The atmosphere was not ideal. But the behavior of manager was really annoying. His demeanor regarding providing a proper seat for the child or their behavior regarding getting the payment by card was unacceptable.
I did not consider writing a review, however, they removed the rating my partner did in google with the cause "defamation".
They cannot refuse any reviews they don't like as defamation.

reviews.author: Sean R.
reviews.text: Löscht Bewertungen!!!! Portionen Klein und dafür sehr teuer. An sich war das Essen sonst gut

reviews.author: Thomas
reviews.text: seit über 10 Jahren zufriedener Kunde (wegen dem Essen) aber so unverschämte Bedienung (gleich 2 ruppige Inder) wie heute habe ich noch nie erlebt. Wollten mich nicht bedienen, weil ich "nur" einen Indischen Tee trinken wollte, nichts zu essen bestellen. Erst als der Chef kam, der mich gut kennt, haben sie klein bei gegeben. Die neue Personalauswahl vom Chef ist, gelinde gesagt, nicht gelungen. Der Chef hat mich dann eingeladen.

reviews.author: Pankaj M.
reviews.text:
One of the great place to enjoy authentic Indian cuisine. They make fresh food and authentic tastes.
The staff is very welcoming and kind to accommodate your requests.

One of the coolest Indian restaurants to try out in Germany.

reviews.author: Jan S.
reviews.text: Netter Service . Gutes Essen , wer gern zum Inder geht muss hierher!!! Vielen Dank und alles Gute für das freundliche Team !

reviews.author: Luan W.
reviews.text: SUPER gutes Essen, das beste Naan das ich je gegessen habe. Bedienung super nett und motiviert.

reviews.author: Noor K.
reviews.text: The host was rather abrupt and cold in fact not at all accommodating when he saw that we were looking to eat dinner and had a small baby. When we requested him if we could do a take out instead the answer was a flat no. A pretty cold and an unwelcoming person. Sorry but it was not what I was expecting at an Indian place that too which is called Jaipur. Disappointed!

reviews.author: Justus R.
reviews.text: Wir sind spät Abends vorbeigekommen und wurden nett aufgenommen, gut verköstigt und sympathisch verabschiedet. Rundum ein sehr angenehmer Aufenthalt. Extrapunkte für das offene Personal

reviews.author: Lil R.
reviews.text: Sehr gutes Essen mit viel Auswahl an vegetarischen/ veganen Gerichten. Sehr sympathisches Personal. Gerne wieder

reviews.author: Akshay Reddy C.
reviews.text: We had been to this restaurant with my infant daughter and it was an awesome experience. The staff, food, location and ambiance everything was great. We have tried mango lassi, dal and mixed veg biryani and liked all the dishes. The cook has adjusted the spiciness according to our daughter and she too has enjoyed the food.

reviews.author: anand S.
reviews.text: As indian craving for north indian food. Food quality is okay. But Naan and indian breads was the best which made the day (food)

reviews.author: Han cu T.
reviews.text: Schöner Laden mit außen Terrasse. Das Essen war lecker. Wir sind nach 21 Uhr gekommen und haben noch was bekommen.

reviews.author: Vivek K.
reviews.text: I have been in the restaurant. Food was so tasty. Service was amazing and the ambience in the restaurant was so nice. People are so good and nice there. Hygiene is also 100% perfect.

reviews.author: Nikita
reviews.text:
Food was amazing and authentic. But the waiters and service was really bad. There is a clear difference in the way they treat fellow Indians and Germans assuming that we don’t speak German. Just to be clear, we speak German at a native level.
Receiving this kind of service from an Indian restaurant is really disappointing!

reviews.author: Adrian S.
reviews.text: Leckeres Indisches Essen, sagenhafte Naans und große Portionen.

reviews.author: Azad N.
reviews.text: Ich war heute da und das war ne sterbe essen und Service und was für ne Ambiente....absolutly empfehlenswert..und Danke an Team jIpur

reviews.author: Moussaab H.
reviews.text: Great food and drinks, friendly staff.

reviews.author: Franck L.
reviews.text: Bonne cuisine mais pas au dessus du lot. La portion est très correcte.

reviews.author: Eberhard F.
reviews.text: Das Essen war sehr gut, die Bedienung sehr kompetent und mit gutem Rat zur Stelle. Sehr empfehlenswert! Das naan mit knoblauch war der Hammer, und ich mag eigentlich knobi nicht so gerne.

reviews.author: Abhijit B.
reviews.text: The food was very nice, the staff was very nice to us and overall they gave us a feel of home.

reviews.author: Shervin S.
reviews.text: We arrived at a very busy time and our waiter seemed overwhelmed. We were overcharged for drinks and had to argue with the manager who made us feel as if we were lying. Check your bill before you

reviews.author: T1bb0r
reviews.text: Very good Location, kind and gentle Service.thank you for the good time here

reviews.author: Joel M V.
reviews.text: Super food , very tasty and good atmosphere all at a considerable price

reviews.author: Ganesh kumar T S.
reviews.text:
Very arrogant and unfriendly reception. We had been to this restaurant around 6.45 pm with kids and elderly parents .
Kids were very hungry and we wanted to dine in but first the manager/owner denied accommodating us  without reservation and in a couple of minutes he managed to prepare a table for six but on a condition to finish the dinner in an hour . Acceptable the condition somewhat reluctantly.
But just before taking the seats he came up with another bizarre condition of cover up charge of 17.50 EUR per head (i.e one must order for minimum €17.50).  Atrocious and obnoxious behavior.
I told him simply that he cannot decide what and for how much we should eat. At once  we quit the place and found a better restaurant nearby.
Will never recommend this restaurant

reviews.author: N. K.
reviews.text: Sehr gutes Essen und Lassi!

reviews.author: Barry M.
reviews.text: Fantastic food in the centre of Freiburg, naan bread to die for and delicious high quality dishes. Friendly staff and good service.

reviews.author: Siddhant G.
reviews.text: The restaurant was great very nice location. The dining experience was also good.

reviews.author: Kwaser
reviews.text: La cuisine était bonne mais nous avons été très mal reçus. Les serveurs ont été plutôt sympathiques mais le gérant a été très agressif et irrespectueux. A notre arrivée il a commencé par nous dire avec agressivité que parfois le terminal de paiement par carte ne fonctionnait pas et qu'il faudrait peut être payer en cash SI ça ne fonctionnait pas. Puis ça s'est transformé bizarrement en "cash only" malgré qu il y avait un terminal de paiement. Ma compagne n'était pas très à l'aise car il était très agressif et insistant sur le cash. A la fin du repas nous avons demandé aux serveurs d'essayer de payer par carte (pour éviter d'avoir à sortir et trouver une banque), ce qu'un serveur à fait, le gérant est arrivé à toute vitesse et à crié sur ses serveurs car il était très mécontent qu'on essaye de payer par carte, il n'était pas du tout d'accord et s'est approché de ma compagne en l'intimidant et lui criant "je vous avais prévenu, je vous l'avait dit ! Cash !" Non seulement c'est très bizarre voire suspect de s'énerver à ce point sur tout le monde parce qu'on essaye d'utiliser le terminal de paiement (si ça n'avait pas marché on aurait simplement été chercher du cash on ne voit pas le problème à essayer) et surtout son comportement était irrespectueux et inacceptable, il a fait peur à ma compagne. Je ne recommande pas du tout ce restaurant, dommage pour les autres salariés qui ont l'air compétents mais personne ne devrait traiter des clients comme ça

reviews.author: Floris B.
reviews.text:
Sehr authentisch und lecker + außerordentlich freundlich
Gutes Preis Leistung Verhältnis

reviews.author: Srivaths S.
reviews.text: This place serves excellent authentic Indian food. Definitely recommend. The service and ambience were also remarkable.

reviews.author: Moe
reviews.text:
Es war alles Bestens, die Gerichte waren sehr lecker. Das Naan Brot hier ist definitiv zu empfehlen.
Die Mitarbeiter waren sehr freundlich

reviews.author: Mathilde L.
reviews.text:
Eine die beste Indische Restaurant außer von Nepal und India für mich.
Das Palak Paneer war voll mit Geschmack, und ich habe endlich eine Chai Tee gefunden, das schmeckt wie in Nepal.
Bravo bravo!!!

reviews.author: deepak K.
reviews.text:
Chicken related food is the best but lamb related dishes are not good at all. I will recommend here chicken biryani which I liked the most. Price is too high compared to all restaurants nearby which is not justified as per its taste. I will recommend to visit occasionally. Hopefully jaipur restaurant will improve its lamb related menus and review it's over inflated price.
Thanks for the food.

reviews.author: Tobias S.
reviews.text: Super leckeres Essen. Ich hatte das Gemüse-Curry ("Mix Veg Curry") und ich fande es top. Naan Brot (als Beilage) und Mango Lassi kann ich auch absolut empfehlen.
